title: MemoryError
description: Error body of the memory HTTP routes (GET and DELETE /v1/memory, the proposal confirmation, PUT /v1/profile/income). Messages are generic and never echo a supplied amount. The x-http-status annotation maps status codes to HTTP responses; it is not a body field.

status.description: NOT_FOUND also covers another user's chain or proposal. PROPOSAL_USED: already confirmed (single use). PROPOSAL_STALE: the chain changed or was deleted after the proposal, or consent was revoked. CONSENT_REQUIRED: the memory consent is missing or revoked.
